r2v.reference_contract: 1..12 connected reference files with at least one image or video; source_asset_id forbidden
r2v.video_layout: Connected videos retain stable user order

v2v.reference_contract: Exactly one connected video and it must equal source_asset_id
v2v.video_layout: The source is ref_videos.ref_video_0 and resolves to <Video 1>

rv2v.reference_contract: Exactly one connected source video plus optional image/audio references; a second video is forbidden
rv2v.video_layout: The source is stably moved to ref_videos.ref_video_0 and resolves to <Video 1>
